jp: 花火職人の義父をもつ
首・桜花と正妻・陽炎
の間に生まれた炎術士
の能力をもつ火影の子
信長の猛威から逃れる
ため陽炎の秘術・時空
流離によって現代へ送
火影党首の血を引く彼
は炎術士の能力を持ち
腕の中に八つの火竜を
同級生の佐古下柳を姫
となって命を賭して守
name: Recca Hanabishi
en:
Family name Hanabishi, given name Recca. A high school student whose adoptive father is a fireworks maker.

A Hokage descendant with the powers of a flame caster, born 400 years ago to Oka, head of the Hokage ninja clan, and his wife Kagero.

To escape Nobunaga's onslaught, he was sent to the present day by Kagero's secret art, Jiku Ruri.

With the blood of the Hokage head, he has a flame caster's powers and commands eight fire dragons in his arm.

For a certain reason, he calls his classmate Yanagi Sakoshita "Princess" and has sworn to be her ninja and protect her with his life.

jp: 烈火と同じ高校に通う
力任せの戦い方をする
とっさの行動でピンチ
火影一の足手まといと
の戦いを通じて大きな
name: Domon Ishijima
en:
Recca's sparring buddy from the same high school.

A power fighter who wins by brute force. Blessed with luck, he gets out of tight spots with snap decisions. But Domon's real strength may be that he runs purely on instinct.

Once thought to be the Hokage's dead weight, he shows huge growth through many battles.

jp: 烈火と同じ高校に通う
格闘好きで烈火や土門
陽炎に魔導具・風神を
鬼の爪を組合せて戦う
負けず嫌いで荒っぽい
が面倒見のいい一面も
name: Fuko Kirisawa
en:
Recca's childhood friend, a high school girl at the same school. She loves to fight and is always sparring with Recca and Domon.

She got the madogu Fujin from Kagero, and in later battles shows a skillful side by combining it with Oni no Tsume. She hates to lose and is rough, but she also takes good care of others.

Her specialty is the Wind Claw.

jp: 姉の形見である魔導具
閻水を武器に復讐の戦
だけに生きる人生の空
name: Tokiya Mikagami
en:
A high school student at the same school as Recca and the others. His sister was killed when he was a child, and perhaps because he lives for revenge, he seems icy cold.

He pursues his revenge with Ensui, the madogu left by his sister. But fighting alongside Recca and the others, he sees the emptiness of a life lived only for revenge, and slowly begins to change.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
紅麗の裏切りの真意を
一員となり烈火たちと
五つの型を持つ魔導具
にも引けをとらず幻の
六の型を完成させ更に
優れた魔導具の使い手
name: Kaoru Koganei
en:
A former member of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

To learn the truth behind Kurei's betrayal, he joined the Hokage and fights alongside Recca and the others.

He uses Kogan Anki, a madogu with five forms. His fighting skill rivals his friends', and by perfecting the phantom sixth form he becomes an even finer madogu user.

jp: 首・桜花と側室・麗奈
の間に生まれた炎術士
の能力をもつ火影の子
烈火が陽炎の秘術・時
空流離で送られた際に
側室の子であった彼は
正室・陽炎に烈火が生
まれたことから周りの
火影忍軍たちに悪魔の
れが原因で烈火を恨み
の母・月乃を人質とし
近衛部隊・麗を従える
森光蘭の手によって殺
された最愛の人・紅を
自らの炎の戦士として
力は烈火の炎をも圧倒
name: Kurei
en:
A Hokage descendant with the powers of a flame caster, born 400 years ago to Oka, head of the Hokage ninja clan, and his concubine Reina. Recca's half brother.

He slipped into Jiku Ruri when Recca was sent away by Kagero's secret art, and survived into the present.

As a concubine's son, he was scorned as a demon child by the Hokage ninja once Recca was born to Kagero, the true wife, and has hated Recca ever since.

And since Koran Mori holds his foster mother Tsukino hostage, he serves him as leader of Uruha, the elite guard.

He has taken his beloved Kurenai, killed by Koran Mori, into himself as his flame warrior, and his power overwhelms even Recca's flames.

jp: 森光蘭によって生み出
された紅麗と紅の遺伝
森光蘭の忠実なるしも
name: Renge
en:
A clone made by Koran Mori, carrying the genes of Kurei and Kurenai. Like Recca and Kurei, she can control flame.

Koran Mori's loyal servant.

jp: 生体魔導具・血種と融
らの血液・魔血を意の
地獄のような戦闘教育
の座を与えられた彼は
戦う使命感のみで戦闘
name: Hiruko
en:
One of the Ura Uruha's Shishiten, known as Hiruko the Undying.

Fused with the living madogu Ketsushu, he fights by controlling the demon blood his body makes at will.

Raised on hellish combat training and given a Shishiten seat in the Ura Uruha, he fights out of sheer sense of duty.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
麗の内部用暗殺部隊・
紅麗が追放にあってか
体がとてつもなく大き
くパワーも人間離れし
魔導具・無名は他の物
と異なり手甲の門構と
name: Kadotsu
en:
A member of the Ura Uruha, the internal assassin unit of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

After Kurei's exile, he hunts Recca and the others as one of Koran Mori's troops.

His body is enormous and his strength inhuman.

Unlike other madogu, his Mumei combines with the gauntlet Mongamae to create all kinds of attacks.

jp: 火影忍軍の魔導具は虚
その海魔が最後に造っ
た火影忍軍最強の魔導
り海魔自身の魂が封じ
危険視された天堂地獄
は長い間封印されてい
満たそうとする森光蘭
の手によって再び目覚
し強大な力を持つ存在
天堂地獄と融合した森
光蘭は完全体となる為
に治癒の少女・佐古下
柳を取り込むべく彼女
奥地で融合の準備をお
name: Koran Mori
en:
The Hokage ninja clan's madogu were made by two men, Koku and Kaima: madogu to give life, and madogu only to kill.

The last madogu Kaima made, the clan's strongest, was "Tendo Jigoku", with Kaima's own soul sealed inside.

Deemed dangerous, Tendo Jigoku stayed sealed for ages, but Koran Mori, set on fulfilling every desire, woke it again and fused with it, becoming a being of immense power.

Fused with Tendo Jigoku, Koran Mori needs the healing girl Yanagi Sakoshita to become complete. He kidnapped her and prepares the fusion deep in SODOM.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
麗の内部用暗殺部隊・
忍法・鏡地獄で対戦相
手の技を真似るのが得
うことで烈火の八竜で
未知の相手の技は真似
name: Kashamaru
en:
A member of the Ura Uruha, the internal assassin unit of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

He excels at copying foes' moves with the ninja art Kagami Jigoku. With the madogu Nisebi he can even copy the eight dragons of Recca, but he can't copy moves of foes he doesn't know.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
木火土金水の五行に属
する木の魔導具・木霊
の根を武器とする植物
対し異様なまでの執着
name: Mokuren
en:
A member of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei. Known as the Heartless Man, Mokuren of Kodama.

A plant user who wields Kodama, a madogu of wood among the five elements of wood, fire, earth, metal and water, and fights with tree roots kept in his body.

Selfish and cruel, he is weirdly obsessed with Recca.

jp: キリトの魔導具・涅槃
によって操られる謎の
巨大な身体から放たれ
る無数の魔弾を武器と
name: Shiguma
en:
A mysterious creature controlled by Kirito's madogu Nehan.

It fights with countless demon bullets fired from its huge body, strong enough to easily wreck SODOM's buildings.

jp: 魔導具・式紙を使い紙
に命を吹き込んで戦う
持病のため長時間戦う
見た目は凄くきゃしゃ
で女の子に見間違うほ
name: Saicho
en:
A member of the fighting group Ku, who uses the madogu Shikigami to breathe life into paper. A chronic illness keeps him from fighting for long.

He looks so delicate he's mistaken for a girl, but he is very much a man.

jp: 烈火と同じ高校に通う
ら同級生の烈火に姫と
呼ばれ守られるように
桜花に守られた沢木家
森光蘭によってさらわ
捕らわれの身となって
name: Yanagi Sakoshita
en:
A high school girl at the same school as Recca. For a certain reason, her classmate Recca calls her "Princess" and protects her.

She has the power of healing and is the reincarnation of Princess Sakura of the Sawaki family, protected 400 years ago by Oka, head of the Hokage ninja clan.

Kidnapped by Koran Mori, who seeks to fuse with her healing power to become complete, she is held captive deep in SODOM.

jp: 火影忍軍党首・桜花の
滅ぶ際に秘術・時空流
離を使い烈火を現代へ
いによって不死の身と
四百年が経過した現代
で再び烈火に出会うが
同じく時空流離によっ
て流れた紅麗との戦い
を見通して烈火に試練
name: Kagero
en:
Wife of Oka, head of the Hokage ninja clan. Recca's mother.

As the clan fell 400 years ago, she used the secret art Jiku Ruri to send Recca to the present, but its curse left her unable to die.

Meeting Recca again 400 years later, she foresees his battle with Kurei, also carried here by Jiku Ruri, and puts Recca to the test.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
麗の内部用暗殺部隊・
森光蘭によって生み出
された紅麗と紅の遺伝
子をもつクローンだが
炎を操ることができず
プレックスを感じてい
紅麗が追放にあってか
魔導具・神慮思考を使
い誘拐した佐古下柳に
マインドコントロール
name: Aoi
en:
A member of the Ura Uruha, the internal assassin unit of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

A clone made by Koran Mori with the genes of Kurei and Kurenai, but unable to control flame, he is called a failure and feels deeply inferior.

After Kurei's exile, he hunts Recca and the others as one of Koran Mori's troops.

With the madogu Shinryo Shiko he puts the kidnapped Yanagi Sakoshita under mind control.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
雷覇の持つ魔導具・雷
そのあまりの強さを抑
えるため雷覇は風神の
核を使っていたが紅麗
を守るために雷神を使
さに逃げ延びた火影の
てくれる紅麗に忠誠を
name: Raiha
en:
A member of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei, and Kurei's ninja.

Raiha's madogu is Raijin. To hold back its overwhelming power, Raiha used Fujin's core, but resolving to use Raijin to protect Kurei, he gives Fujin's core to Fuko.

He descends from Hokage who fled to save their own skins when the Hokage ninja clan fell 400 years ago. Ashamed of his bloodline, he swears loyalty to Kurei, who accepts him for it.

jp: 烈火の中に潜む火竜の
忍者であり各忍の成し
遂げられぬ想いから火
を晴らしてくれる炎術
士の為に力を貸す存在
他の封印された火竜と
スーパーでワンダホー
な力によって現実世界
に謎のジジィとして現
name: Koku
en:
One of the fire dragons in Recca's arm. Once a ninja of the Hokage ninja clan, he became a fire dragon from the unfulfilled wishes of each ninja, and lends his power to the flame caster who will lay their regrets to rest.

Unlike the other sealed dragons, by what he calls his "super wonderful-o power" he appears in the real world as a strange old man and gives Recca and the others all sorts of advice.

jp: 格闘集団・空の師範代
ばれ対戦者の二度まで
の攻撃には平穏で耐え
面で力を貸してくれる
name: Kukai
en:
Assistant master of the fighting group Ku. A pure brawler who uses no madogu.

Even Buddha's patience lasts only three times. Also called Kukai the Buddha, he calmly endures a foe's first two attacks, but on the third his whole personality changes.

After his match with the Hokage, trust grows between them and he lends his strength in many situations.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
釈廻天を使い重力変化
自由を愛し麗の中でも
何ものにも縛られない
独自のスタイルを歩ん
時に烈火たちと行動を
共にすることもある変
name: Joker
en:
A member of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei. A tough fighter who skillfully shifts gravity with the madogu Taishaku Kaiten.

He loves freedom and walks his own style, bound by nothing, even within Uruha.

An odd guy who sometimes even teams up with Recca and the others. Speaks with a Kansai accent.

jp: 魔導具・輪廻により自
らの年齢を自在に変化
共に変化する自分の本
当の姿を忘れてしまい
それを知る恐怖から森
光蘭の誘いに乗り手下
もうひとつの魔導具・
涅槃を使って死愚魔を
name: Kirito
en:
One of the Ura Uruha's Shishiten.

With the madogu Rinne she can change her age at will, but as both mind and body change, she forgot her true self. Afraid to learn it, she took Koran Mori's offer and became his underling.

With her other madogu, Nehan, she controls Shiguma.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
魔導具・毒魔針と人型
魔導具・魅虚斗を使い
残虐非道な戦いを主に
name: Mikoto
en:
A member of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

A vile woman warrior who fights brutally and ruthlessly with the madogu Dokumashin and the humanoid madogu Mikoto.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
麗の内部用暗殺部隊・
魔導具・海月と朧の二
つを使いこなすナルシ
学力をひけらかし戦い
で自らの身体に傷がつ
くことをひどく嫌って
name: Tsukishiro
en:
A member of the Ura Uruha, the internal assassin unit of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

A narcissistic pretty boy who has mastered two madogu, Kurage and Oboro.

He shows off his smarts and hates having his body scratched in a fight.

jp: 紅麗率いる暗殺集団・
麗の内部用暗殺部隊・
同じく裏麗の一員であ
る魔元紗の弟で魔導具
風子との対戦で敗れて
な場面で戦いを共にす
name: Gashakura
en:
A member of the Ura Uruha, the internal assassin unit of Uruha, the assassin group led by Kurei.

Younger brother of Magensha, also of the Ura Uruha, and wielder of the madogu Tsuchigumo.

Since losing to Fuko, he has built trust with Recca and the others and fights alongside them in many situations.
